ONLY REMAINING: in-game confirm an emptied flagged lot still fires its acquisition flag so the check registers (repros: Ash of War: Lightning Ram 540310, Ornamental Straight Sword 510030). Ships in 0.2.9. [2026-07-26: COMPLETE -- confirmed by Alaric. Carded done; the bridge closes the issue.]

title: Progressive flask grants both axes (intentional)
desc: 📋 TRACKED-INTENTIONAL (not a bug — filed so it stops re-surfacing as one): every Progressive Flask Upgrade grants BOTH a flask charge AND a consumed Sacred Tear (flaskLadder + progressiveGrants) in greenfield/eldenring/features/progressive.py (PROG_FLASK). The original design ALTERNATED rungs (Golden Seeds vs Sacred Tears); switching to both-axes-per-copy was a deliberate change for DLC-ONLY seeds, to catch the player up faster (DLC layers its own Scadutree/Revered economy on top of base flask progression). dlc_only injects 12 copies when no seed/tear checks are kept. Both modes are viable: progressive-on = both-axes (DLC catch-up default); progressive-off = vanilla Golden Seeds + Sacred Tears. Possible future enhancement (low, not blocking): restore the alternating seed/tear schedule as a BASE-GAME option while keeping both-axes for DLC. Already documented in-file; this card is the record of WHY.

title: Restore rune-shop arbitrage (randomize shop costs)

A consumable rune (Lord's Rune, ~50k on use) landing in a shop cheaper than its value → buy for ~2k, consume for ~48k (fun). WHY it's gone: gen_data's GOODS_PRICE now derives each rerolled item's price from what it's WORTH (vanilla price → EquipParamGoods.basicPrice → sellValue x10, gen_data.py ~3186-3227), so nothing is ever underpriced. Fix (Alaric) — split pricing by STOCK TYPE: FINITE one-time rows (the shop_rows.tsv AP checks: eventFlag_forStock>0 AND sellQuantity>=1) all get a seed-seeded random cost in [0, 5000] — the fun one-shot flip; INFINITE-stock rows (INFINITE_SHOP_ROWS, sellQuantity -1) stay priced AT COST / at-worth so you can’t infinitely farm the arbitrage. Deterministic from the seed.

title: merchant_shops.tsv over-attributes shop rows at BLOCK level
desc: FOUND 2026-07-26 while removing the Twin Maiden Husks from seller lists. One ShopLineupParam row is attributed to every merchant whose talk ESD touches its block, so block 1000 claims Gatekeeper Gostoc, Sorceress Sellen and THREE name-states of Bernahl (Knight / Recusant / Sword of) alongside the Husks; block 1005 lists Merchant Kale, 'Nomadic Merchant' and an EMPTY name. This is the old 'block = one merchant' fallacy inverted -- now every block collects a pile of merchants instead of exactly one. Consequences: descriptors name sellers who do not stock the ware, and the same NPC appears as several people. The Husks rule shipped in d89dee5 removes the one name Alaric could prove misleading, but on block 1000 it may be dropping the RIGHT seller while keeping wrong ones. Root fix is in tools/datamine_merchant_shops.py (needs the params) plus deduping NPC name-states.

title: Shop slots show each AP item's proper name (not the shared "Archipelago Items" label)
desc:
🛒 Shop shelves show "Archipelago Items / Reusable" with "AP: 54 DIFFERENT items share this shelf slot's name…" instead of the real item name (screenshot from playtest). That's `shop_shared_label()` (`from-software-archipelago-clients/crates/er-logic/src/name_override.rs:167`) working **as designed** — the honest-shared-name mitigation for Funnyfail's 2026-08-16 Nexus report ("all AP items from Kale look like 'Arrows(10)'… in reality they are completely different items"). Better than a confident wrong name, but the player experience is still "go check the tracker" for most of a big shop.

Root constraint: the spare-goods pool is **65 renameable rows** (`tools/datamine_spare_goods.py` — a spare must already own an FMG entry to be renameable at all) against as many as **501 shop checks**, and the FMG write is once-per-session. Surplus slots share a goods row, and a row has ONE name.

Proper per-slot names need a new technique. Candidate directions:
1. **Rename on hover/selection** — rewrite the shared row's FMG entry when a slot is highlighted instead of once per session (the buy menu only shows one slot's details at a time).
2. **Grow the pool** — find/synth more FMG-owning goods rows so fewer slots share.
3. **LookupEntry hook with slot context** — the `NameTable`/`Override` machinery (module doc, `name_override.rs:1-10`) already supports per-id Redirect/Custom substitution; needs the hook to know WHICH slot is being rendered when several share a row id.

Sibling of #109 (same shared-row problem on the pickup-popup surface).
